description: Update a Google Business location profile, hours, or attributes (one field group per call). Actions: update_hours (regular_hours.periods), update_attributes (attributes), update_description (description, max 750 chars, no URLs or phone numbers), update_categories (categories with primary_category and up to 9 additional_categories; carries over existing additional categories when omitted), update_services (service_items, replaces the full list or clears services when empty; free-form categories must belong to the location), update_title (title), update_phones (phone_numbers with primary_phone and up to 2 additional_phones; carries over existing additional phones when omitted), update_website (website_uri). Every action uses preview then confirm with a one-time token: call without confirm to get a preview and preview_id, show it to the user, then call again with confirm=true and that preview_id. Title and primary category edits warn that Google may hold the change for review and that an inaccurate name or category can get the listing suspended. Stays off until location edits are switched on; a confirm while it is off changes nothing and does not call Google.

account_id.description: Google Business account ID from list_accounts.

action.description: Which location field group to update.

attributes.description: update_attributes: attributes to set. URL values must be https. Names look like attributes/has_wifi.

categories.description: update_categories: { primary_category, additional_categories? } with categories/gcid:... resource names (max 9 additional; existing additional categories are carried over when omitted).

confirm.description: Leave out to get a preview; true only with the preview_id after the user approved it.

description.description: update_description: business description (max 750 chars, no URLs or phone numbers).

location_id.description: Google Business numeric location id (the location_id/platform_user_id from list_accounts, e.g. "197940849675145390"). NOT the ChIJ... Place ID from list_google_business_reviews view=review_link. Prefer account_id.

phone_numbers.description: update_phones: { primary_phone, additional_phones? } (up to 2 additional; existing additional phones are carried over when omitted).

preview_id.description: The preview_id from the preview call. Required with confirm: true.

regular_hours.description: update_hours: opening periods. Days are MONDAY-SUNDAY. Times are HH:MM.

service_items.description: update_services: full replacement list of structured_service_item or free_form_service_item entries (pass [] to clear all services).

title.description: update_title: public business title on Google.

website_uri.description: update_website: public website URL (http or https).

workspace_id.description: Filter to a workspace ID from whoami.

name: manage_google_business_location
